page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question
Classification of Elements – Periodic Properties · 2 marks

steps.label: The law
lines: Modern periodic law: the physical and
chemical properties of the elements are
periodic functions of their atomic numbers.
steps.why: The law replaces Mendeleev's atomic weight with atomic number, because atomic number — the proton count — is what fixes the electronic configuration and therefore the properties.
common_mistakes: Writing atomic weights in place of atomic numbers. That is Mendeleev's law, not the modern law.
Saying only chemical properties. The law covers physical properties as well.
steps.memory_tip: Mendeleev sorted by weight; the modern law sorts by atomic number.
steps.margin_note: The phrase periodic functions of their atomic numbers carries the mark.

steps.label: Who proposed it
lines: His X-ray studies showed that the atomic
number, not the atomic weight, is the
The long form of the periodic table is built
steps.why: Moseley measured X-ray frequencies of the elements and found they follow the atomic number exactly — the experimental proof that atomic number is the right ordering quantity.
common_mistakes: Crediting the modern law to Mendeleev. Mendeleev's law used atomic weights; Moseley's work gave the modern law.
steps.memory_tip: Moseley, X-rays, atomic number — the three go together.
steps.margin_note: The year 1913 is extra detail; the name Moseley is the marked word.

insider_note: Half of this two-mark question is a single name. A full and correct statement of the law that stops there loses that mark outright, so answer the second question in the first line you can.
